To prevent stupid things from showing up on our feeds, a user should be able to "rate" other voaters based on how much you liked their previous voting history. From then on, a rated user's vote gets a multiplier so that an upvote from a highly rated user counts more than an upvote from a poorly rated user. The catch is that if I rate a user, that rating only applies to how I view a post's rating. This allows for me to rate a user that I like more highly and see more posts that they up vote while simultaneously allowing you to rate them poorly and see less of the posts that they upvote.

This would in effect create a personalized voat feed.
